correctness.rationale: Exact alternating symplectic normal form gives polar ideal I_V^[q], Euler identity implies F in the Jacobian ideal, and regular sequence gives Hilbert series and degree. Smooth transverse projective base gives normality via Serre; one explicit blow-up along the linear vertex is smooth, and adjunction gives discrepancy 2r-q-2. The single smooth exceptional divisor permits log discrepancy threshold classification. Fedder criterion gives non-F-purity; GL/Sp orbit count gives all-rank embedded census. Quantifiers are q any prime power N≥5 2r≥4 corank≥1. Standalone exact checker independently verifies finite special cases but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete nonreduced local singularity and birational threshold classification, combined with exact rank-stratum frequency, for the entire normal singular portion of the natural minimum-degree space-filling linear system. In particular cubic characteristic-two canonical vertex cones can fail F-purity, while rank-four families pass from canonical to merely lc to non-lc as q changes. This is a geometric rank phase diagram, not a marginal increment or arbitrary finite example.
